commentary.text: 90+7' Jesus Gil Manzano shows a yellow card to Daley Blind (Girona) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+7' Girona take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

90+6' Yangel Herrera (Girona) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Girona.
90+5' Yan Couto slides a brilliant pass into Valery (Girona), but his shot from inside the box goes a whisker wide of the right post.
90+5' The resulting set piece from Girona is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+4' Daley Blind (Girona) attempts to curl the ball over the wall from the free kick, but one of the defenders deflects it away from danger. Girona force their opponents to concede a corner.
90+4' Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jesus Gil Manzano no option but to blow his whistle.
90+3' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
90+1' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
90+1' Real Sociedad are ruled offside.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' Referee halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Michel, then promptly shows him a RED CARD!
88' Yangel Herrera (Girona) will miss the next game.
88' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Yangel Herrera (Girona) was quite harsh and Jesus Gil Manzano didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
87' Imanol Alguacil has decided to make a change. Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) replaces Andre Silva.
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jon Ander Olasagasti (Real Sociedad) comes onto the pitch for Brais Mendez.
83' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) has a shot blocked from inside the box.

81' Yangel Herrera (Girona) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
80' Here is a change. Aleix Garcia is going off and Michel gives the last tactical orders to Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona).
80' Substitution. Valery (Girona) in, Viktor Tsygankov out.
77' One of the Real Sociedad players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
77' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Real Sociedad.

73' Real Sociedad force a corner. They send men into the box.

60' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Real Sociedad.

56' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The referee signals a corner kick to Real Sociedad.
55' Neat passing move from Girona in order to create new attacking opportunities.
52' Imanol Alguacil is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Sheraldo Becker suffers an injury and Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) comes on.
52' Substitution. Benat Turrientes did his best and is replaced by Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad).
52' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
51' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) collects a pass on the edge of the box but he slips the ball just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
49' So close! Andre Silva (Real Sociedad) tries a curler from the edge of the box, but it slides just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
47' Girona concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
46' The whistle blows and Jesus Gil Manzano starts the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Referee Jesus Gil Manzano halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Imanol Alguacil, then shows him a yellow.
45+1' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jesus Gil Manzano had an easy-decision to make.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
43' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Real Sociedad.
41' Andre Silva (Real Sociedad) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
39' Savio (Girona) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
38' It looks like Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) saw red with that tackle. Jesus Gil Manzano won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
37' Portu (Girona) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
35' One of the players from Girona times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
33' Rough tackle by Eric Garcia (Girona). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
31' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
29' Dangerous play by Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad). Jesus Gil Manzano blows his whistle for a foul.
27' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Girona due to an offside in the build-up play.
26' The Girona players halt their celebrations as referee Jesus Gil Manzano makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
24' Savio shows his great technique and produces a beautiful cross into the box. Yangel Herrera (Girona) gets on the scoresheet by heading the ball precisely inside the right post. It's now 1:0.
23' Girona take a short corner kick.
21' Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
18' Girona are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
15' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) commits a rough foul. Jesus Gil Manzano stops the game and makes a call.
15' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the right post only for Alex Remiro to dive and make a save.
14' Javi Galan (Real Sociedad) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
13' The referee blows his whistle as Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) was too aggressive in his challenge.
13' One of the Real Sociedad players commits a holding foul and the referee reaches for his whistle.
10' Jesus Gil Manzano blows for a foul after Andre Silva (Real Sociedad) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
8' Jesus Gil Manzano interrupts the game. One of the players from Girona won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
6' Girona enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
3' Imanol Alguacil is forced to make a change. Alvaro Odriozola is unable to continue due to injury, Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) comes on.
